entities.summary: Martin Bodin was a Swedish cinematographer. Martin Bodin was born at the Baltic Island of Gotland in 1903. He worked for the Swedish film studio Svensk Filmindustri from 1930 to 1968, photographing more than 85 films. He died in Sollentuna north of Stockholm in 1976.
